description: This file defines the class 'FieldUiLocalAction' which provides local action definitions for entity bundles in Drupal's field UI module. It dynamically generates derivatives for routes related to creating and reusing fields for different entity types.

classes.name: FieldUiLocalAction
classes.description: Provides local action definitions for all entity bundles, generating derivatives for field creation and reuse routes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with route provider and entity type manager dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinitions
methods.description: Generates derivative route definitions for each entity type that has a 'field_ui_base_route'.
